newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Hamon's IPO priced at 2,280 francs.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Hamon's IPO priced at 2,280 francs.

text.p: Belgian cooling tower maker Hamon, which on Monday launched an initial public offering of 325,000 shares on the Brussels bourse, on Tuesday closed the offer after heavy demand at a price of 2,280 francs.
The price was at the top end of the price fork of 2,050 to 2,280 francs. The bookbuilding had been due to run from June 9 to June 20.
Subscriptions for the shares will be closed at 1600 (1400 GMT) on Friday, June 13, issuer Paribas Bank said in a statement.
